parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_runs (message_id, sender_email, subject, received_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, message_id;

UPDATE agent_runs
SET status = $2,
    category = $3,
    confidence = $4,
    language = $5,
    reason = $6,
    error_message = $7,
    input_tokens = COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) + $8,
    output_tokens = COALESCE(output_tokens, 0) + $9,
    cost_usd = COALESCE(cost_usd, 0) + $10
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status, category, confidence, cost_usd;

SELECT *, $2::text AS batch
FROM eval_cases
WHERE COALESCE($3::text, '') = ''
   OR case_id = ANY(string_to_array($3::text, ','))
ORDER BY case_id
LIMIT $1::int;
